{'text': '邊界警區助理指揮官（行動及刑事）警司陳啟澤表示，今日下午4時12分，警方接報指一名本地女子倒臥於坪洋村111號屋內草地，昏迷不醒。警方及救護員到場後發現該名女子，並在其身旁發現一隻徘徊的唐狗。救護員檢查後，證實該女子死亡。', 'target': 'Border Division Assistant Commander (Operations and Crime) Senior Inspector Chan Kai-tak said police received a report at 4:12pm today that a local woman was found collapsed and unconscious on the grass at a house at 111 Ping Yeung Village. Police and paramedics found the woman on arrival and discovered a stray mongrel wandering beside her. Paramedics confirmed the woman was dead after examination.', 'segments': None}

{'text': '陳啟澤表示，邊界警區刑事部接手調查。現場為一間持牌寵物酒店及犬隻訓練中心，今年一月開始營業，並無搜掠痕跡。警方翻查閉路電視片段，發現下午約兩時，女子於室外草地餵飼該唐狗後，打算將狗放回籠內，狗隻不願進入狗籠，並襲擊該女子。', 'target': 'Chan Kai-tak said the Border Division Crime Unit had taken over the investigation. The site was a licensed pet hotel and dog training centre that had been in operation since January this year. There were no signs of burglary. Police reviewed closed-circuit television footage and found that at around 2pm, after the woman had fed the mongrel on the outdoor grass, she attempted to put the dog back into its kennel. The dog refused to enter the kennel and attacked her.', 'segments': None}

{'text': '警方指，閉路電視最後畫面顯示，該女子與該唐狗離開狗舍，往草地方向走去。警方指，女死者33歲，為寵物酒店持牌人，案發時只有她一人在酒店工作。死者的頭部、下顎、頸部及雙臂均有不同程度撕裂及由動物造成的咬痕。涉事唐狗為一歲雄性唐狗，今年8月11日由狗義工帶來寄養，希望有人領養。法醫、愛護動物協會、漁農自然護理署及勞工處人員在現場協助調查。唐狗將由漁護署接走。', 'target': 'Police said the last footage from the CCTV showed the woman and the mongrel leaving the kennel and heading towards the grass area. The dead woman was 33 years old and was the licence holder of the pet hotel. She was the only person working at the hotel at the time of the incident. The woman had lacerations and bite marks of varying severity from an animal on her head, jaw, neck and both arms. The mongrel involved was a one-year-old male and had been brought in for boarding by a dog volunteer on August 11 this year, in the hope it could be adopted. A forensic pathologist, and personnel from the Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (SPCA), the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department (AFCD) and the Labour Department were at the scene to assist with the investigation. The mongrel will be taken away by the AFCD.', 'segments': None}

{'text': '警方指會調查是否有違規或疏忽之處。警方指，狗隻在女子仍在生時施襲，女子與狗隻其後離開狗舍，前往狗舍外的草地。死因有待剖驗確認，死者被襲時清醒，唐狗施襲過程約一分鐘，唐狗身長約一米。現場另有六隻狗隻，當時全在狗籠內。', 'target': 'Police said they would investigate whether there were any violations or negligence. The dog attacked while the woman was still alive, and the woman and the dog subsequently left the kennel and headed towards the grass area outside. The cause of death is subject to confirmation by autopsy. The woman was conscious when attacked. The attack by the mongrel lasted about one minute, and the mongrel was about one metre in length. There were six other dogs at the scene, all of which were in kennels at the time.', 'segments': None}
